description.zh:
水平转动速度参数，正值表示向左水平转动。  
取值：-1.0~1.0
description.en:
Pan speed. A positive value moves the camera left.
Valid values: -1.0 to 1.0

description.zh:
垂直转动速度参数，正值表示向上水平转动。  
取值：-1.0~1.0
description.en:
Tilt speed. A positive value moves the camera up.
Valid values: -1.0 to 1.0

description.zh:
缩放速度参数，正值表示放大。  
取值：-1.0~1.0
description.en:
Zoom speed. A positive value zooms in.
Valid values: -1.0 to 1.0
